messages.content:
Olájùmoke; A Woman helped by God.

Olájùmoke; A Woman whose worth is far above rubies.

Olájùmoke; Angels and elders salute you, O woman of strength.

Thank you for everything that you do. Thank you for being my mini mum. Thank you for always laying my nappies. Thank you for always putting balm on my chest when it rains so that I'd not catch cold. Thank you for bringing me to Christ. I can't thank you enough for showing me the WAY. Thank you for the urgent 5k's. Thank you for the clothes, bags and heels(we go again this year). Thank you bearing our burdens. Thank you soo much.I love you soo much.🥹🫂❤️

Happy birthday, Olájùmoke. The Lord bless you, keep you and cause His face to shine upon you. You will never loose your relevance. You're blessed, helped, favoured by God and greatly aided by men. Amen.🤲🏾
Olájùmoke; Adáralókàn, O how I love being your sister.🤍✨

Dear sister,

I don’t think I say this enough, but I’m really grateful for you.

For the way you listen and how safe I am to talk to you.  For the way you make ordinary days feel lighter just by being there. You have this quiet way of showing up that means more than you probably realize. Days when we don’t talk, I know I’m in your corner

Thank you for the laughs we didn’t plan, for the honesty we can share, and for the comfort of knowing I don’t have to pretend around you. That kind of friendship is rare, and I don’t take it for granted.

No matter where life takes us, I’ll always appreciate what we have. You’ve made a difference in my life simply by being yourself—and that’s something I’ll carry with me. I love you Olajumoke.
Looking forward to those vacation trips with you

My sister,

I am really grateful to God for you, your being, and your journey. Being your sister has earned me the privilege of seeing how your life has unfolded from childhood till now, and all I can say is that God is really intentional about you.

I have never said this to you before now, but one of the things I'm grateful for is your yieldedness to God.
I could say that, I was only able to see the Light when you saw it.
You are indeed a first born!
I am grateful for how strong you are. You have deposited your own strength on Bolu and I; and in moments when I start to feel weak, a call from you sets the tone right again.

Thank you for standing by me every time it mattered. From my choice of course, to when an adult bullied me, to every day-to-day challenge, you are a very reliable backbone. (Thank God for you in the life of my dada). Not many know that I can talk or even fight, because I hide behind you, and you cover me well.
I'm glad to tell you that 'He that has walked with you up until now has come too far to leave you hanging, now or ever'. God is a Finisher, and He will not leave you halfway.

This is just the beginning of God's goodness to you. I pray that the Lord showers you more and more with His blessings and kindness, and that you enjoy the mercies of God.

I love you so much, Olajumoke.

HAPPY 25TH BIRTHDAY, MY LOVE❤️

Hey girl, you are 25!! Now you’re marking the end of your early twenties…love itttt.

This is another perfect time to remind you of how much you have grown. I still remember your 10th birthday, you in that orange and grey lace with your orange headgear, and every other birthday we have celebrated together.
Thank you for being a good friend to me over the years. Thank you so much for walking through life with me. Thank you for cheering me on and believing in me.

I want you to know that I am so happy for you. I am glad you’re in God’s favour. I am glad you did not allow life and circumstances to be unfair to you. I am glad you picked yourself up and showed the world you can. I am so proud of the woman you’ve become….responsible, brave, accomplished, and true to yourself.

Today, I do not just want to celebrate your birthday, but to honour you and celebrate the woman you’re becoming. I believe with everything in me that one day, you’ll look back and say you gave life your best. Until then, do not doubt your worth, do not dim your light, and never forget God, because He has given you all that you’ll ever need.

Whenever you feel down, remember Psalms 34:18.
Whenever you feel weary and tired, remember Galatians 6:9.
Whenever you doubt your worth, remember Isaiah 43:4.
Whenever you need help, remember Psalms 121.

Always remember Psalms 119:165: when you’re grounded in God’s Word, you’re not easily shaken or offended. Let God’s Word give you peace that protects you from being easily offended. Not everything should move you, and not everything deserves your energy. God says He is building strength in you, where you stay steady.

May all your dreams come true according to God’s will for your life, my darling. May the Lord give you grace to stay grounded in Him. Amen.

I love you so much, my love. ❤️
To my favorite person: Happy 25th! You bring so much light into the lives of everyone around you. Cheers to a year as amazing as you are.

Happy birthday to the fiery woman who has been an example of strength for me and people around her, happy birthday to the soft babe with a tiny bit of hard exterior, to a sister who always looks out for her brother 🌚 and looks for his trouble 9 out of 10 times, to a woman who effortlessly makes me laugh more than any other person!!!

Happy birthday to a woman who shows diligence to things she does, to the woman who's intentional about everything that concerns her. Oh, how grateful I am to God for the gift of this person. I count my blessings, and I count you a million and one times.

Welcome to a new chapter, my love, and with all of my heart, I pray that the Lord beautifies your life with His glory, transforming every ash into beauty, and surrounding you with His grace, favor, and splendor. 
I sincerely pray that the Lord remains the source of your joy! I pray that He remains your biggest lover as He continues to overshadow you with His love. May He grant you all your heart's desire according to His will, as your name implies, may the Lord pamper you!

People will see you, and it'll be obvious that this is someone cherished by God. May the Lord wipe every tear from your eyes, may the Lord uphold you! May the Lord take you to greater heights in your career (so you can spoil usss), may the Lord continually guide your path, may the Lord be your rock and shelter, you'll see more of God this year!

The Lord will reveal more and more of Himself to you across every area of your life, so keep trusting, keep yielding, because those who look to him for help will be radiant with joy; no shadow of shame will darken their faces. - Psalms 34:5

And I am certain that God, who began the good work within you, will continue his work until it is finally finished on the day when Christ Jesus returns.- Philippians 1:6. 

He will keep you strong to the end so that you will be free from all blame on the day when our Lord Jesus Christ returns. - 1 Corinthians 1:8.

I pray that your love will overflow more and more, and that you will keep on growing in knowledge and understanding. For I want you to understand what really matters, so that you may live pure and blameless lives until the day of Christ’s return.  - Philippians 1:9-10

Happy birthday, my love. I love you so much, and I can't wait to see the goodness of God unraveled in your life. Keep shining, my happy baby and fiery woman! Keep living, here's to a softer version of you 🌚. I love you 3000.
Please, less tyranny this year. You don dey old
